clue.text: In which monarch might be trapped?

parts.words: In which monarch might be trapped?

definitions.text: What might be read as warning to the mob?

parts.words: What might be read as warning to the mob?
parts.note: an old British law had to be read aloud to an unruly crowd, ordering it to disperse; today reading it means a stern telling-off

the word It's minus its apostrophe
